title: 2305: Reduce white-space in "Perception Outcomes" form
body: Fixes #2305

issues.title: Reduce white-space in "Perception Outcomes" form
issues.body:
We use tables to let the umpire enter multiple outcomes from an interaction:
![Screenshot 2023-01-30 at 16 42 52](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/215549571-641ed286-84dc-40d0-aaff-32a85d12f30b.png)

But, for perception there are lots of columns, and it's difficult to see all of the text.

Can we reduce the whitespace?

It would be good to reduce:
- the left& right padding in the drop-down lists
- the padding between the columns
- the padding around the table

I've tried to highlight these in red in the above attachment.

Get the form using this story:
http://localhost:6611/?path=/story/local-organisms-adjudicationmessageslist--one-open-interaction
